tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: The accounting systems this API key can read (e-conomic, Dinero, Billy …): id, system, company.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: One page of invoices from the accounting system, canonical model (amounts in øre). Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: vat_by_quarter
tools.description: Output VAT, input VAT and VAT payable per quarter (øre) from the synced invoices.

tools.name: profit_and_loss
tools.description: Resultatopgørelse (profit and loss) for a period: revenue and expense lines, result (øre).

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: Bookkeeping proposals waiting for (or past) human review.

tools.name: create_proposals
tools.description: Scan for anomalies and file them as DRAFT proposals in JaKonto for a human to approve. Never writes to the accounting system. Idempotent per open finding.
